<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Orange gate / blue transforms / purple Linear / green Sigmoid / yellow Add.</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Three branch inputs are the same current x; carry is a learned Linear, not a skip identity.</tspan>

</text>

<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>

<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="1066" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
